input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An automated system is designed to detect and remove harmful content, utilizing algorithms to identify and flag inappropriate posts. The system aims to reduce the prevalence of objectionable material, promoting a safer online environment. It works in conjunction with human evaluators to improve the accuracy and efficiency of content moderation.
